findings.text: The gate paragraph quotes '68 passed in 47.3 s at f4a8ef887b' as the head arm's log, but no log in the run directory carries that summary: after_suite-head.log and scoped-gate-1794956760.log are both at revision 8bf50b476f and read '68 passed in 52.82s' and '68 passed in 53.13s', the only '68 passed in 47.33s' text is a tool result in resume-3.jsonl:1205 that no reader can open as a receipt, and commit 8bf50b476f exists to replace exactly such an unreceipted figure. The number therefore cannot be reconciled with the log the paragraph names, in the one artefact whose purpose is to carry evidence.

The log opens with '# command:' and carries no '# revision:' line, unlike every other gate log in the run directory, so the revision it reddened is unnamed; its failing ids and '3 failed, 7 passed', EXIT=1 summary are present and the in-window case is among them.

negative_control_note states the head arm log 'was rerun at the run head 789d5c72627f', while after_suite-head.log:1 and the manifest's own after_suite JSON both name 8bf50b476f99d6aa2553cb2c3b118778b4924b7c, so the note dates the arm to a superseded revision.
